XLVII. Gif ðeowmon wyrce on Sunnandæg be his hlafordes hæse, sie he frioh, ⁊ se hlaford geselle XXX scill. to wite.
Si seruus operetur die dominica per preceptum domini sui, sit liber, et dominus emendet triginta sol. ad witam.

If a slave works on Sunday at his lord’s command, let him be free, and the lord must pay 30 shillings as fine.
If a slave works on Sunday by his lord's command, he shall become free, and the lord shall pay a fine of 30 shillings.
Wenn ein Sklav am Sonntag arbeitet auf seines Herrn Geheiss, werde er frei, und der Herr gebe 30 Schill. zur Strafe.
If a slave works on Sunday at his lord’s command, let him become free, and let the lord give 30 shillings as a fine.
